en.hero_p1: Most commercial decisions are made blind, for lack of a connected capability.
en.hero_p2: We build it. Connecting data, decisions, and execution end-to-end. Deployed where the need is greatest. Integrated with what works. Replacing what doesn't.
en.hero_close: Not a tool. Not a one-off project. The intelligence that operates commercial growth.
en.col_ruido_p: That channel reports aggregate sales, but not the actual closing price, the terms granted, or how the plan was executed at the point of sale. With that gap, next month's pricing and promotion are decided on a sales report and what the team remembers.
en.col_ruido_h: The channel that bills the most is the one measured the least.
en.col_senal_h: The missing data, organized around one decision.
en.col_senal_p: Pricing, promotions, portfolio and channel stop being argued separately once the information arrives together, on time and under one criterion.
en.col_resultado_h: And the criterion holds the following month.
en.col_resultado_p: A decision becomes operation once it is settled who decides, within what limits, and by when.
en.prob_intro: These are not exceptional situations. They are the default operating condition in most fragmented markets.
prob_items: No market visibility
Sales data says what was sold. Not what happened at the point of sale, in the distribution chain, or in competitive positioning.
Fragmented, incomparable data
Multiple sources. Different formats, cadences, reliability levels. No single working truth, every team operates on a different version of reality.
Analysis that never becomes decisions
Reports circulate. Dashboards exist. Pricing, promotions, and portfolio priorities remain unchanged, because the link between insight and action was never built.
Decisions that never reach execution
Strategies defined in planning cycles dissolve before reaching the field. Without governance, playbooks, and measurement, the best analysis produces no result.
No feedback loop
Execution is not measured against a baseline. The operation does not learn. The same structural mistakes repeat across cycles.
en.prob_close: Imberion was built to solve all five, as a single operation.
en.arms_lead: Built to work as a full loop, or deployed where the need is greatest.
en.arm_a_h3:
We build the visibility
that does not exist yet
en.arm_a_p: The market sends signals that are not captured yet. Market Signal reads the external market: competition, prices, the point of sale. Floor Signal reads the physical floor: shopper, journey, shelf, and the sales conversation, with computer vision and audio. We sense them, harmonize the data, and consolidate it into a single structured base. From scattered signals to one reliable picture. This is where the work starts, not where it ends.
en.arm_b_h3:
We convert that visibility
into commercial decisions
en.arm_b_p: This layer combines economic modeling, behavioral validation, and AI-assisted decisioning to turn fragmented data into concrete commercial actions. This is AI-enabled. We operate the models and own the analysis: on the client side there is no platform to administer. Decisions arrive, integrated into the existing way of working.
en.arm_c_h3:
We stay until
the value is captured
en.arm_c_p: Most engagements stop at the recommendation. We turn intelligence into action in two modes. We operate the engine: Concierge runs omnichannel customer interaction (takes orders, recommends, and serves) through the Companion, a conversational layer with live dashboards; and Training Signal coaches the salesforce, with each product's pitch and negotiation rehearsals against Account Twin. Or we equip the internal team: installed capability, ways of working, dashboards, and governance, so the decisions stick. Either way, we track results against baseline and stay until the value is captured.
en.arm_loop: Imberion is built as a continuous commercial operation. Every cycle sharpens the next decision, improves execution, and compounds value over time.
en.arm_a_preview_caption: From scattered sources to a single structured commercial base.
en.arm_c_preview_caption: Deploy the decision. Capture the value. Close the loop.
en.arm_b_preview_caption: Simulate trade-offs. Decide with AI-assisted clarity.
en.mod_lead: Each module can operate independently. They are designed to work together, sharing data, context, and scenario logic across every commercial lever.
en.solve_body:
Most companies can answer some of these questions.
Very few can act on them, consistently, at scale.
solve_bullets: With data fragmented and unreliable, what can we actually trust to decide?
In which markets and channels is the growth we can actually win?
What price captures real value, by channel, pack, and customer?
Which part of the portfolio creates growth, and which just takes up space?
Who is behind each ticket, and how do we bring them back?
Which commercial investment pays off, and which leaks away?
What happens at the point of sale that the report never sees?
en.solve_bridge: And the hardest part: turning each decision into execution that holds.
en.solve_close: From decision to execution, and back again.
en.impact_h2: The range a well-run commercial operation moves.
en.impact_cta: Book a call to see what this looks like in the operation →
impact_stats: Reallocate trade and promo to what converts.
en.impact_foot: Reference ranges from comparable markets; actual results depend on the starting point. Impact visible from weeks 6–8 in pilots.
en.who_lead: The common thread is not the industry. It is the structural condition: fragmented channels, incomplete data, and commercial decisions made without a reliable picture of the market.
who_cards: Understand the market beyond sell-in data alone. Price and promote with discipline. Align trade investment to measurable performance.
Structure commercial information and turn it into a differentiator. Become an intelligence node between manufacturers and retail.
Connect fragmented downstream data. Make execution visible, measurable, and governable.
en.mat_h2:
There is no need
to be ready.
en.mat_p1: Most organizations believe they need to "be ready" before they start.
en.mat_p3: Commercial maturity is not a prerequisite, it is the outcome.
en.mat_p4: We've started from scattered spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and incomplete data.
en.mat_p5: That's not the exception. It's the typical starting point.
en.mat_p6: We grow at each client's pace.
en.checkup_lead: A commercial entry diagnostic. It x-rays the operation: strategy, pricing, governance, ways of working. It builds an initiative matrix with a business case and leaves an actionable playbook. The low-risk way in.
en.sect_lead: Imberion applies wherever commercial complexity creates an information gap.
en.team_p1: Built by people who have solved this before. Not in theory, in complex, messy, real-world environments.
en.team_p2: We come from top-tier strategy, AI, and advanced analytics. We’ve worked on pricing, promotions, portfolio, and commercial transformation where the stakes are real and the data is imperfect. We don’t build frameworks. We build capabilities that work, because we’ve seen what happens when they don’t.
en.team_clients: A selection of organizations our team has served:
en.cta_h2:
Ready to go from
noise to signal?
en.cta_lead: A 30-minute call to locate exactly where the gaps are and what it takes to close them.
en.persp_lead: Imberion's take on market, pricing, and AI that operates. Published on LinkedIn, distilled here.
persp_cards: The value of an ICP is measured by the customers it leaves out.
An ICP is a binary decision: who gets a yes, and who gets a no. Its job is to protect focus.
The register records what sold. Not what almost sold.
A system that watches and listens to the floor turns the shopper's hesitation into signal: where they stop, what they compare, what they ask for, and what makes them put it back.
The buyer persona stopped being a portrait. Now it's an agent that can be interrogated.
Software trained on real data that reproduces how a shopper decides. A pricing or pack decision gets tested against it before it ships.
en.estrat_h2:
Before operating growth,
deciding where to grow.
en.estrat_lead: The operation runs growth. Upstream sits the strategic decision: which markets to compete in, what prize is there, and whether it can be won. It's where the most capital is committed with the least certainty.
estrat_cards: Market Sizing & Right-to-Win
Size the prize and test whether it can be won, before investing.
Market Entry & GTM
Attractiveness by occasion, route to market, and risk, to decide go or no-go.
Value Creation & Capital Allocation
Profit pools, inorganic growth, and disciplined capital allocation.
Commercial & Operating Model
Strategic reset, RTM redesign, and governance that makes strategy stick.
en.loop_cap: The operation learns on every loop.

es.hero_p1: La mayoría de las decisiones comerciales se toman a ciegas, por falta de una capacidad conectada.
es.hero_p2: Nosotros lo construimos. Conectando datos, decisiones y ejecución de punta a punta. Desplegado donde más se necesita. Integrado con lo que funciona. Reemplazando lo que no.
es.hero_close: No es una herramienta. No es un proyecto puntual. Es la inteligencia que opera el crecimiento comercial.
es.col_ruido_p: De ese canal llega la venta agregada, pero no el precio real de cierre, las condiciones otorgadas ni la ejecución en el punto de venta. Con ese hueco, precio y promoción del mes siguiente se deciden con el reporte de ventas y la memoria del equipo.
es.col_ruido_h: El canal que más factura es el que menos se mide.
es.col_senal_h: El dato que faltaba, ordenado alrededor de una decisión.
es.col_senal_p: Precio, promoción, portafolio y canal dejan de discutirse por separado cuando la información llega junta, a tiempo y con el mismo criterio.
es.col_resultado_h: Y el criterio se sostiene el mes siguiente.

es.prob_h2: Cinco razones por las que fallan las decisiones comerciales
es.prob_intro: Estas no son situaciones excepcionales. Son la condición operativa por defecto en la mayoría de los mercados fragmentados.
prob_items: Sin visibilidad del mercado
Los datos de ventas dicen qué se vendió. No qué pasó en el punto de venta, en la cadena de distribución, ni en el posicionamiento competitivo.
Data fragmentada e incomparable
Múltiples fuentes. Formatos, cadencias y niveles de confiabilidad distintos. No hay una sola verdad operativa, cada equipo opera con una versión diferente de la realidad.
Análisis que nunca se convierte en decisiones
Los reportes circulan. Los dashboards existen. Los precios, promociones y prioridades de portafolio no cambian, porque el vínculo entre insight y acción nunca se construyó.
Decisiones que nunca llegan a la ejecución
Las estrategias definidas en planeación se disuelven antes de llegar al campo. Sin gobierno, playbooks y medición, el mejor análisis no produce resultado.
Sin feedback loop
La ejecución no se mide contra un baseline. La operación no aprende. Los mismos errores estructurales se repiten ciclo a ciclo.
es.prob_close: Imberion fue construido para resolver los cinco, como una sola operación.
es.arms_lead: Diseñado para operar como un loop completo, o desplegado donde la necesidad es mayor.
es.arm_a_h3:
Construimos la visibilidad
que aún no existe
es.arm_a_p: El mercado emite señales que aún no se capturan. Market Signal lee el mercado externo: competencia, precios, punto de venta. Floor Signal lee el piso físico: shopper, journey, anaquel y la conversación de venta, con visión y audio. Las captamos, homologamos y consolidamos en una base estructurada. De señales dispersas a una imagen confiable. Aquí es donde empieza el trabajo, no donde termina.
es.arm_b_p: Esta capa combina modelado económico, validación conductual y decisioning asistido por AI para convertir data fragmentada en acciones comerciales concretas. Nosotros corremos los modelos y somos dueños del análisis: del lado del cliente no hay plataforma que administrar. Llegan decisiones, integradas a su forma de trabajar.
es.arm_c_h3:
Nos quedamos hasta
que el valor es capturado
es.arm_c_p: La mayoría de los proyectos se detiene en la recomendación. Convertimos la inteligencia en acción en dos modos. Operamos el motor: Concierge lleva la interacción omnicanal con los clientes (toma pedidos, recomienda y da servicio) a través del Companion, una capa conversacional con dashboards vivos; y Training Signal capacita a la fuerza de ventas, con el argumento de cada producto y ensayos de negociación contra Account Twin. O equipamos al equipo interno: capacidad instalada, ways of working, tableros y gobierno, para que las decisiones se sostengan. En ambos casos medimos resultados contra el baseline y nos quedamos hasta que el valor se captura.
es.arm_loop: Imberion está construido como una operación comercial continua. Cada ciclo afina la siguiente decisión, mejora la ejecución y acumula valor con el tiempo.

pt.persp_lead: A tese da Imberion sobre mercado, pricing e AI que opera. Publicadas no LinkedIn, destiladas aqui.
persp_cards: O valor de um ICP se mede pelos clientes que ele deixa de fora.
Um ICP é uma decisão binária: para quem se diz sim e para quem se diz não. A função é proteger o foco.
O caixa registra o que foi vendido. Não o que quase foi vendido.
Um sistema que observa e escuta o piso transforma a dúvida do shopper em sinal: onde ele para, o que compara, o que pede, e o que o faz devolver o produto.
O buyer persona deixou de ser um retrato. Agora é um agente que se pode interrogar.
Software treinado com dados reais que reproduz como um shopper decide. Uma decisão de preço ou pack é testada contra ele antes de ir ao ar.
pt.estrat_h2:
Antes de operar o crescimento,
decidir onde crescer.
pt.estrat_lead: A operação corre o crescimento. Antes está a decisão estratégica: em quais mercados competir, qual prêmio existe e se dá para ganhar. É onde mais capital se compromete com menos certeza.
estrat_cards: Market Sizing & Right-to-Win
Dimensionar o prêmio e testar se dá para ganhar, antes de investir.
Market Entry & GTM
Atratividade por ocasião, rota ao mercado e risco, para decidir go ou no-go.
Value Creation & Capital Allocation
Profit pools, crescimento inorgânico e alocação de capital com disciplina.
Commercial & Operating Model
Reset estratégico, redesenho RTM e governança que sustenta a estratégia.
pt.loop_cap: A operação aprende a cada volta.
